id.description: Base id for the component. Month/day/year field ids and hint ids are derived from this.

groupHint.default: Select a month. Enter 1 or 2 digits for the day and 4 digits for the year.
groupHint.description: Visible hint shown once for the whole group. Hidden from screen readers (aria-hidden) since each field has its own hint.

monthLabel.description: Label text for the month select.

dayLabel.description: Label text for the day input.

yearLabel.description: Label text for the year input.

monthHint.default: Select a month from the dropdown.
monthHint.description: Screen-reader-only hint for the month field.

dayHint.default: Enter 1 or 2 digits for the day.
dayHint.description: Screen-reader-only hint for the day field.

yearHint.description: Screen-reader-only hint for the year field.

monthName.description: name attribute for the month select. Defaults to <id>-month.

dayName.description: name attribute for the day input. Defaults to <id>-day.

yearName.description: name attribute for the year input. Defaults to <id>-year.

ariaDisabled.description: Marks all three fields aria-disabled without preventing interaction, matching USWDS's aria-disabled variant.

required.description: Marks the fieldset and all three fields as required.

error.description: Error message shown once below the fields, referenced by all three fields' aria-describedby.

className.description: Additional classes for the usa-fieldset wrapper.
